key_insight: The paper introduces two robust multigrid preconditioner families for unfitted finite element discretisations of the de Rham complex that maintain solver performance despite cut cells and complex geometries.
engineering_relevance: These preconditioners can make mixed Hodge Laplacian and related electromagnetics/flow simulations more reliable and scalable on meshes that do not conform to the boundary.
method: Geometric multigrid directly on unfitted operators with star-patch smoothers on an aggregated mesh.
Auxiliary-space multilevel preconditioner combining a cut-cell patch smoother with a body-fitted solve on the active mesh.
Both serve as block-diagonal preconditioners for mixed Hodge Laplacians in H(grad), H(curl), and H(div).
evidence_signal: The abstract reports two- and three-dimensional numerical experiments showing iteration counts robust to cut configuration, mesh size, and number of levels, including higher-order and weak-Dirichlet variants.
watch_item: The approach relies on careful aggregation, patch construction, and stabilization choices, which may increase implementation complexity for general unfitted meshes.
paper_title: Geometric multigrid preconditioners for unfitted discretisations of the de Rham complex
